name: Invoicefacts.linenetamt converts currencies, tenant 1000036 (six of them)
note:
The existing invoicefacts-net case covers tenant 1000026, which invoices ONLY in EUR - so it passed throughout while the measure was arithmetically broken for everyone else. Tenant 1000036 invoices in six currencies (CZK, EUR, HUF, PLN, RON, USD) and its amounts were summed at FACE VALUE:

    before conversion   20,481,105
    after conversion    13,990,240
    overstated by        6,490,865   = 46.4%

Almost all of it was 5.7M Hungarian forint added as though they were euros.

Conversion uses iDempiere's own currencyconvert() with the document's own conversion type and date, targeting the currency of the tenant's accounting schema - looked up from c_acctschema, not hardcoded. A literal currency id would be the same defect class as the hardcoded tenant removed from Storage.

The reference here mirrors ALL the cube's filters. Two earlier attempts did not and looked like model defects: omitting the credit-memo sign flip gave 14,354,333, and omitting the docstatus gate gave 14,028,195. The cube was right both times.

UPDATED: the reference used min(c_currency_id) over the client's schemas and converted at dateinvoiced. It now uses the same org-aware rule as the model - c_acctschema.ad_orgonly_id, then a client-wide schema, then ad_clientinfo.c_acctschema1_id - and converts at dateacct. Neither change moves this tenant's figure: 1000036 has a single accounting schema, and the two dates agree inside this window. The reference was updated so it encodes the rule we believe correct rather than the one that happened to be equivalent here.
referenceSql: SELECT round(sum(currencyconvert(CASE WHEN charat(dt.docbasetype::character varying,3)::text='C' THEN il.linenetamt*-1 ELSE il.linenetamt END, i.c_currency_id, (SELECT s.c_currency_id FROM c_acctschema s LEFT JOIN ad_clientinfo ci ON ci.ad_client_id=s.ad_client_id WHERE s.ad_client_id=i.ad_client_id ORDER BY (s.isactive='Y') DESC,(s.ad_orgonly_id=i.ad_org_id) DESC NULLS LAST,(COALESCE(s.ad_orgonly_id,0)=0) DESC,(s.c_acctschema_id=ci.c_acctschema1_id) DESC,s.c_acctschema_id LIMIT 1), i.dateacct, i.c_conversiontype_id, i.ad_client_id, i.ad_org_id)),0) AS value FROM c_invoice i JOIN c_invoiceline il ON il.c_invoice_id=i.c_invoice_id JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.c_doctype_id=i.c_doctype_id WHERE i.ad_client_id=1000036 AND i.docstatus = ANY (ARRAY['CO','CL']) AND i.dateinvoiced >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.dateinvoiced < DATE '2026-09-01'
